notes: All 113 tests collect and fail with NotImplementedError (the python -m subprocess test fails on returncode 1 for the same reason). 101 in tests/e2e (marker ui), 12 in tests/unit/test_services_config_store.py (marker unit).

tests/e2e/conftest.py is lane-private (tests/e2e/** is owned by lane-tdd-ui); it does NOT touch tests/conftest.py. Fixtures: make_env (ConfigStore on tmp file + FakeVault + FakeServiceFactory + AppController, built inside the test body so stubs FAIL rather than ERROR), no_app_quit (records QApplication.quit).

FakeCameraService uses tapo_desktop.core.media_engine.supervisor.{StreamState,Frame} when importable, else structurally identical local stand-ins; the controller must only rely on state.name and frame.width/height/data.

Behaviour details binding for Wave 3 are spelled out in the stub module docstrings (controller.py, grid.py, main_window.py, controls_panel.py, playback_panel.py, camera_dialog.py, tray.py, video_tile.py, config_store.py, app.py).

Harness idioms were sanity-checked in a throwaway script (not committed): FakeCameraService streaming/fail/download, DirectConnection to Python callables, QComboBox Key_Down emits activated+currentIndexChanged offscreen, QPushButton press/release, QMainWindow.close() returns False when ignored, QTest key/dclick delivery. No full reference implementation was built, so a test that is unsatisfiable for a subtle reason is still possible.
